meaningOfComplete: Saved decision-set failure and architecture requirements are explained. This is not complete identification of every feature's causal effect or proof that D30 generalizes.
primaryMechanisms: D30_ONLY_ENTRY_DECISION_OBJECTIVE_MISMATCH: risk-only admission replaced the v1 opportunity-quality gate over all 3800 candidates; it did not merely veto v1 ENTERs.
ADMISSION_DISTRIBUTION_AND_TIMING_SHIFT: many lower-opportunity entries were added, and an earlier v2 ENTER latched some later v1 decisions.
LOCAL_FALSE_RISK_REJECTIONS: risk rejection removed low-D30 +3/+5 paths as well as genuinely adverse paths; a global precision-dilution problem coexists with localized winner sacrifice.

secondaryRootCauses.qualification: D30 measures adverse magnitude, not upside quality. This does not establish that D30 is an invalid risk target.

Ridge score has a positive risk coefficient in 19/24 models and positive association with opportunity. Aggregate term attribution supports a trade-off, but no ablation or numerical-score correlation was performed.
5 of 6 chronological rejected +5 memberships belong to 89180; broad precision failures persist across every complement-group calibration. No symbol rule is justified.

otherRootCauseDispositions.qualification: There are high-risk/high-opportunity rejected paths, but 8 unique low-risk/high-opportunity rejected events show the sacrifice is not entirely unavoidable intrinsic overlap.
No feature augmentation, selection or ablation is permitted; saved evidence cannot establish that adding a field solves this problem.
No model-family comparison; numerical inner predictions were not persisted, so residual/calibration diagnostics cannot be regenerated here.
All direct risk rejections in 24 units have both market-state inputs available. Missing-input false accepts remain descriptive; their counterfactual effect is unknown.
Large measured precision shifts and real winner/tail errors exist. No gate relaxation is justified from these results.

targetDiagnosis.question: Does D30 have stable predictive risk value across symbols, beyond decision-set composition?
targetDiagnosis.evidence: Mean D30 versus v1 improves in all 4 chronological units, but rejected mean D30 exceeds accepted mean in only 2/4 units. Relative to already-saved tau5, tau2 changes mean D30 by -0.0563/-0.0525/+0.0033/-0.0186 percentage points. No actual >=10 D30 paths were directly rejected in those units. Numerical-score diagnostics and held-symbol OOF are absent.
targetDiagnosis.secondary: A_D30_TARGET_HAS_SIGNAL_BUT_DECISION_RULE_FAILS remains a plausible partial explanation, not a demonstrated predictive claim.

architectureDiagnosis.secondary: A_RISK_VETO_DIRECTION_VALID_BUT_TOO_AGGRESSIVE applies only to localized winner rejection; overall tau2 admission is permissive.
notEstablished: Futility of every future risk-veto architecture
architectureDiagnosis.support: Current standalone D30-only admission does not satisfy the frozen combined quality/risk gates. A broad rejection of risk-veto families is not supported.

nextArchitectureRecommendation.action: A separate Pre-Development Contract should distinguish minimum opportunity quality from adverse-risk control, retaining the Frozen Selector. Consider the meaning and eligibility of each axis before any model change.
nextArchitectureRecommendation.notAnAutomaticImplementationChoice: Does not authorize a second model, Two-Head implementation, v1 intersection training, additional features, a new threshold, score product, WAIT, XGBoost, or a D30 target replacement.
nextArchitectureRecommendation.dataRequirement: Any separately authorized future run must persist per-candidate numeric predictions, masks and decision reasons. This review does not regenerate them.
nextArchitectureRecommendation.portfolioIssue: Track unresolved valuation/cash-lock semantics independently. Do not use the 173 complete-case +23.05% as a full-stream baseline or fabricate liquidation.

limitations: Inner numerical predictions were not persisted by the prior Development run.
No held-symbol outer OOF exists; complement-group calibration stability is not unseen-symbol evaluation.
MFE winner means historical high-touch opportunity, not executable or realized profit.
Calibration windows and repeated symbols are dependent; per-unit evidence is primary.
Per-input term associations cannot establish counterfactual feature effects.
exactNextAction: STOP. Separate user instruction for an Alternative Architecture / v2.1 Pre-Development Contract based on this evidence. No fit, prediction, implementation, gate change, Fresh or OOS now.
